source.boundary: The retained independent reviewer assessed the source-only plans before fixture authoring. FSRC-001 corrected elemental references from15.8(Simple procedures) to15.9.1/15.9.3 before these fixtures were authorized.

fixtures.method: The coordinator independently reread the original FINAL constraints and reviewed the complete generator, source templates, controls, source limitations and regressions. Exact generated bytes bind that assessment to all64 actual cases. No compiler acceptance was used as source authority.

independent_reviews.context_limit: Source-review context was retained. This is not a fresh-context-per-pass, new-model benchmark or runtime-finalization review.

source_and_isolation_premises: FINAL has a nonempty subroutine-name list and optional double colon. Scalar and rank-one families keep the list/comma controls free of a signature conflict.
A final dummy is nonpolymorphic TYPE(record), not a C765 CLASS passed object. Every otherwise eligible dummy has the defining ordinary type, permitted attributes and all LEN parameters assumed.
The zero-dummy repair adds the signature and declaration together, without a recursively finalized record local. Removing the second dummy leaves a plain INTEGER local with no dummy-only attributes.

The nonmodule pair retains a complete ordinary external interface with IMPORT after the prior type and complete external/module definitions. Only its FINAL selector changes; an ordinary interface body does not turn an external procedure into a module procedure.
The coarray dummy has otherwise valid explicit[*] coshape without SAVE or ALLOCATABLE. VALUE is tested with INTENT(IN), not a second OUT/INOUT, POINTER or ALLOCATABLE conflict.
Each LEN negative fixes exactly one actual LEN while the other remains assumed. Legal mixed declaration syntax is distinct from the stronger C791 all-assumed condition.
Repeated FINAL statements are repaired by removing the whole redundant statement. Case-equivalent names denote the same actual procedure, not another distinct signature.

C793 uses full abstract KIND tuples and fixed ranks. Each full-tuple control changes only one KIND coordinate; LEN remains assumed. The ordinary/elemental conflict is repaired by changing the ordinary rank, not making an elemental dummy an array.
C794 assumed-rank exclusivity cannot be evaded by a different fixed rank at the same KIND tuple. Repairs remove the competing FINAL designation but retain otherwise valid procedure bodies.
All bodies are empty and every fixture is compile-only. No observer, linked executable, finalization event, image configuration or IS_FINALIZABLE substitute is claimed.

independent_signature_models.method: Read the inspected generated signature layouts, map each declared abstract KIND coordinate by header order, preserve LEN as assumed, and distinguish scalar, vector and assumed rank. Evaluate duplicate fixed-kind/rank and assumed-rank same-kind exclusion independently.
independent_signature_models.result: Every C793/C794 negative satisfies its intended conflict predicate; every control/admission satisfies both constraints. The competing constraint remains false for each negative in this finite set.
independent_signature_models.limit: These are finite models over actual source declarations, not a general Fortran parser, compiler execution or finalization-order proof.

source_only_case_rationales.R753_invalid__missing_name_bare: Bare FINAL lacks a name list; inserting the already defined finish is the sole repair. Generic newline/name/END recovery remains unqualified.
source_only_case_rationales.R753_invalid__missing_list_separator: Two otherwise eligible final names lack their comma. Its insertion repairs the list without changing scalar/rank-one interfaces; generic token recovery is not the selected FINAL-list cause.
source_only_case_rationales.C791_invalid__nonmodule_procedure: The ordinary interface and out-of-module definition identify an external procedure. The control changes only the FINAL selector to the complete module procedure. Compiler acceptance does not override C791's module-procedure restriction.
source_only_case_rationales.C791_invalid__coarray_dummy: The sole dummy has otherwise valid explicit[*] coshape and no SAVE/ALLOCATABLE. Removing its coshape repairs C791. No runtime coarray or optional-availability inference is involved.
source_only_case_rationales.C791_invalid__polymorphic_dummy: CLASS(record) is otherwise a legal dummy for this extensible type, but a FINAL dummy must be nonpolymorphic. TYPE(record) alone repairs the property; an already-matching-type complaint is not the nonpolymorphism cause.
source_only_case_rationales.C791_invalid__value_dummy: VALUE appears with scalar TYPE(record), legal INTENT(IN) and no competing POINTER/ALLOCATABLE/OUT issue. Its removal repairs C791; silence or unrelated type recovery is not corroboration.
source_only_case_rationales.C791_invalid__length_n: Only n is explicit in TYPE(record(2,*)); m is already assumed. TYPE(record(*,*)) is a source-valid control accepted by GNU, but its current n-specific negative cause remains unqualified.
source_only_case_rationales.C791_invalid__length_m: Only m is explicit in TYPE(record(*,3)); n is assumed. Changing only m to* repairs the final-dummy condition without a KIND/signature conflict. Other processors' valid-control failures do not change source validity.
source_only_case_rationales.C793_invalid__full_kind_tuple: Both scalar finals initially have KIND tuple(1,2) with LEN assumed. Independent first-coordinate(2,2) and second-coordinate(1,3) controls distinguish the full tuple. A rank-only diagnostic is insufficient for the tuple predicate; Flang's exact report remains f2018.

diagnostic_qualification.verifier_boundary: LFortran's correct-looking dummy-count text emitted as an ASR verify pass error remains a compiler failure, not a language diagnostic. Broad ranges or a count-word match do not bypass this veto.
diagnostic_qualification.wording_boundary: The accepted forms are finite cause qualifications, not standard-mandated messages, fatal exits or printed rule codes. Generic recovery and wrong property/parameter reports are not promoted merely to obtain reference agreement.

observations.provenance_limit: Every selected processor record matches its actual original row, fingerprint, input hashes, command, phase and source context. Separate reference-only runs do not manufacture a target result or one fictitious combined run. No f2018 row is relabelled f2023.
